description: This file defines the ReportsProvider class, a ChangeNotifier used in a Flutter application to manage and notify about monthly expense reports. It interacts with a transactions repository and a use case to fetch and update report data based on the selected month.

classes.name: ReportsProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that provides report data for a specific month and notifies listeners on updates.

methods.name: ReportsProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with required dependencies and loads the current month's report.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and updates the report data for the specified month, then notifies listeners.
